headline: Canva releases its first AI image generation model
summary: Canva released its first in-house image generation model, Canva Craft, which plans a design in two stages before generating an image and is positioned against models from OpenAI, Microsoft and Google.

claims.statement: Canva released its first in-house image generation model, called Canva Craft.

sources.quote: Canva releases its first image generation model

claims.statement: The model uses a two-stage architecture that plans a design before generating the image.

sources.quote: uses a two-stage architecture that allows it to plan a design before generating an image

claims.statement: The model is being made available to all users and promises better performance at lower cost.

sources.quote: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs

claims.statement: The model competes directly with image models from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google.

sources.quote: competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google
